name: Rocket Fuel - (5g) Baller Bucket - Runtz
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, bulk size. The Rocket Fuel Runtz Baller Bucket packs a full 5 grams of live resin — full-spectrum concentrate extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with. Bold, flavorful, and built for people who go through it.

Runtz is a fan-favorite hybrid born from crossing Zkittlez with Gelato, and it earned its name honestly. Expect a candy-forward profile: sweet tropical fruit and sugary berry notes up front with a smooth, creamy finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect — a potent, balanced experience that brings a happy, uplifting buzz alongside easy full-body relaxation.

Why you'll love it:

5G live resin — bulk value in one bucket, fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Runtz flavor — sweet candy fruit and sugary berry with a creamy finish
Bucket packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Rocket Fuel Runtz is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
